data.heading: There is a door in the leather.
data.intro: In 1920 the sign out front said soft drinks and the drinking moved to the basement. The basement is still down there. So is the door.

password.question: In 1920 the sign changed and George Berg sold something over the counter. What?
password.hint: It is still on the taps, in a frosted mug.

riddles.question: Who put up this building in 1881 and poured the first beer in it?
riddles.right: The brewery that built the room. The lock turns.

riddles.question: The brewery owned the room, and the room could pour only its beer. The arrangement was called a…
When nobody was watching, what sometimes went into the root beer mug?
riddles.right: Kept in a bottle under the bar. Keep moving.

riddles.question: When the sign said soft drinks, where did the drinking go?
riddles.right: Down here. You are standing in it.

riddles.question: Sixty years later Orv and Pat ground half-pound burgers behind the bar and called them…

reward.title: The Back Room
reward.fallback: Say it at the bar. Quietly.
